description: This source file contains unit tests for a queue implementation, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests queue operations such as insert, post, remove, extract, and control functions like enable, disable, and flush.

classes.name: QueueType<int>
classes.description: A queue template class instantiated with int, used for testing queue operations.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an item into the queue with a specified priority.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Posts or signals the queue, possibly to wake up waiting threads.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the queue.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Extracts an item from the queue, likely removing it and returning it.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the queue.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables the queue, possibly allowing operations to proceed.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears the queue of all items.
